name: Enchanted Encounters
source:
Trapped in a sudden snowstorm—in the middle of July—you stumble upon a lonely shed deep in the woods. Inside, you find warmth, mystery… and a handsome stranger named Hans. As the storm rages outside, strange magic begins to stir between you. Is Hans merely another traveler caught in the cold, or something far more enchanted? 

[From [url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/enchanted-encounters]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
七月中旬，你被困在一场突如其来的暴风雪中，你偶然发现了树林深处一座孤独的棚屋。在里面，你会发现温暖、神秘……还有一个名叫汉斯的英俊陌生人。当外面的暴风雨肆虐时，奇怪的魔法开始在你们之间搅动。汉斯只是另一个受寒的旅行者，还是更令人着迷的东西？

[来自[url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/enchanted-encounters]itch.io[/url]]
